title: Download a store's QR code for its mobile store site
summary: Download a transparent PNG QR code that opens a store's mobile store site, for use on signage, print and packaging.
bodyMd:
Every store has a QR code that opens its mobile store site. Download it as a transparent PNG from the store's Store Details tab and use it on window signage, counter displays, receipts or packaging so customers can join the queue, book an appointment or browse offers from their own phone.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with the Admin role.
  • A mobile site template published under Platform Admin → Enabled Features → Mobile Store Sites. See Define your default mobile site template.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Stores / Branches.
  2. Select the store name. The store opens on the Store Details tab.
  3. In QR Control - Mobile Site Template, check that the template the QR code should open is selected, for example Mobile App. If you change it, select Save Changes.
  4. Select Download QR-Code for Store Site (Transparent PNG). The PNG file downloads to your device.
The QR code shown in the Retail Admin Add Visitor to Queue dialog is a different code: it takes the visitor straight into joining that store's queue. Use the store-site QR code from this page for printed material.

Verify it worked

Scan the downloaded PNG with a phone. The store's mobile store site opens with the header and menu items defined in the selected template.
